Name: Japanese Garden Shrubs
Author: moriAHIRU
Description:
[b][size=5]Japanese Garden Shrubs[/size][/b]

Add a variety of Japanese-inspired shrubs, flowering plants, and artificial grass to Stardew Valley.
Create a peaceful Japanese-style garden, decorate the area around your buildings, add greenery along paths, or simply give your farm a little more life.

[heading]🌿 Features
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52831/52831-1790234416-1739888850.png[/img][/heading]
Japanese Garden Shrubs
Adds decorative plants that can be placed as furniture.
[list]
[*]Blue Hydrangea[/*]
[*]Purple Hydrangea[/*]
[*]Pink Azalea[/*]
[*]White Azalea[/*]
[*]Spiraea[/*]
[*]Kerria[/*]
[*]Osmanthus[/*]
[*]Red Camellia[/*]
[*]Pink Camellia[/*]
[*]Shrub[/*]
[/list]Several variations are available for some plants, allowing you to create more natural-looking gardens without having every plant look exactly the same.
Place them wherever you like to create gardens, hedges, flower beds, or small landscaped areas around your farm.

[heading]🌱 Artificial Grass
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52831/52831-1790234420-867888280.png[/img][/heading]
Adds 6 artificial grass floor colors for garden landscaping:
[list]
[*]Green[/*]
[*]Light Green[/*]
[*]Dark Green[/*]
[*]Brown[/*]
[*]Dull Green[/*]
[*]Blue Green[/*]
[/list]Mix and match the different colors to create paths, garden areas, planting beds, and other decorative spaces.
Artificial grass can be crafted in-game using Fiber.

[heading]📖 Japanese Garden Catalogue
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52831/52831-1790234425-1060862830.png[/img][/heading]
The mod also adds a [b]Japanese Garden Catalogue[/b] containing all of the added plants.
[b]Catalogue price: 25,000g[/b]
Once you purchase the catalogue, the plants inside it can be taken out and placed [b]for free[/b].
This makes it easy to experiment with different garden layouts without having to purchase every plant individually.

[heading]💰 Regular Plant Prices
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52831/52831-1790234416-714513138.png[/img][/heading]
The catalogue itself costs 25,000g, but plants taken from the catalogue are free.
[heading]🏡 What Can You Use It For?[/heading]
[list]
[*]Japanese-style gardens[/*]
[*]Traditional-looking farm layouts[/*]
[*]Shrub borders around buildings[/*]
[*]Flower beds[/*]
[*]Greenery along paths[/*]
[*]Pond and garden decoration[/*]
[*]Landscaping around sheds and other buildings[/*]
[*]Adding more greenery to your farm[/*]
[/list]Whether you want to build a carefully designed Japanese garden or just add a few shrubs around your farmhouse, these plants are designed to give you more freedom when decorating your farm.

[heading]📦 Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/*]
[*]Furniture Framework 3.3.0+[/*]
[*]Content Patcher 2.8.0+[/*]
[/list]Furniture Framework and Content Patcher are both required.
The mod includes both content packs in a single download.

[heading]📥 Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Download [b]Japanese Garden Shrubs[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]JapaneseGardenShrubs[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]
🌿 Enjoy Your Garden![/heading]
This is a decorative mod focused on giving you more options for creating gardens and landscaped areas.
Take your time, experiment with different plants and grass colors, and create a garden that feels like your own.
